payload.summary: scope: the terminal CLI loop. Renders hand, current room, adjacency, public event log, and deduction notes; parses the command vocabulary (move, suggest, accuse, ask, notes, save, quit); routes every command to the engine for the outcome and to the game master for narration; displays the engine fallback when narration is unavailable; prints session token usage on exit. Entry point 'bun run src/cli.ts', and '--help' must exit 0 (the run contract healthcheck). Depends on engine and game-master.
